notes: No target selected from row order, numeric values or requested metric. Cohen's f^2 is requested, but inspected regression table prints unstandardized B, standardized beta (canonical text b), SEB and adjusted delta R-squared; Results discuss delta R-squared effect sizes. No f^2 conversion performed. Multiple candidate tests prevent assigning a printed alternative metric or p bound. Examples only, not extracted target values: p. 401 Results gives baseline neuroticism b=.05 with p<.05 for BMI and WHR and b=.06 with p<.01 for WC; p. 404 Results gives longitudinal extraversion WHR b=.05, p<.05 and WC b=.06, p<.01; gender interaction effect sizes are delta R-squared=0.01. PDF Table 3 visually confirms beta standardization and both p legends. Canonical text loses some minus signs in coefficients; candidate signs are not inferred from it. Candidate N values are printed directly, not summed or derived from df. Table 3 provides different T1 and T2 model Ns, so there is no single common N across all candidate tests. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Rendered and visually inspected PDF pages 4–6 (printed pp. 401–403).
